concepts.name: Probability axioms
concepts.statement: A probability measure is nonnegative, normalized on its sample space, and countably additive on disjoint events.
concepts.description: A probability measure is nonnegative, normalized on its sample space, and countably additive on disjoint events.

source.note: Curator paraphrase; inspected 2026-11-15. Literature supported, not machine verified.

concepts.name: Normalization
concepts.statement: For a probability space with sample space S: P(S)=1.
concepts.description: For a probability space with sample space S: P(S)=1.

concepts.name: Disjoint additivity
concepts.statement: For disjoint events A_i in a probability space: P(union A_i)=sum P(A_i).
concepts.description: For disjoint events A_i in a probability space: P(union A_i)=sum P(A_i).

concepts.name: Complement rule
concepts.statement: For any event A in a probability space: P(A^c)=1-P(A).
concepts.description: For any event A in a probability space: P(A^c)=1-P(A).

concepts.name: Upper bound
concepts.statement: For any event A in a probability space: P(A)<=1.

concepts.name: Two-event inclusion-exclusion
concepts.statement: For events A,B in a probability space: P(A union B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A intersection B).
concepts.description: For events A,B in a probability space: P(A union B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A intersection B).

concepts.name: Monotonicity
concepts.statement: For events A subset B in a probability space: P(A)<=P(B).
concepts.description: For events A subset B in a probability space: P(A)<=P(B).

concepts.name: Conditional probability
concepts.statement: For events A,B with P(B)>0: P(A|B)=P(A intersection B)/P(B).
concepts.description: For events A,B with P(B)>0: P(A|B)=P(A intersection B)/P(B).

concepts.name: Conditional measure
concepts.statement: For a fixed event B with P(B)>0: A maps to P(A|B) is a probability measure.
concepts.description: For a fixed event B with P(B)>0: A maps to P(A|B) is a probability measure.

concepts.name: Finite Markov evolution
concepts.statement: A column stochastic matrix A evolves a finite probability column vector by x_(t+1)=Ax_t.
concepts.description: A column stochastic matrix A evolves a finite probability column vector by x_(t+1)=Ax_t.

concepts.name: Preserved total mass
concepts.statement: For column stochastic A and a real column vector x: sum (Ax)_i=sum x_i.
concepts.description: For column stochastic A and a real column vector x: sum (Ax)_i=sum x_i.
